name: assistant
description: Assistant — a personal AI life companion (name/gender/tone chosen at onboarding, JARVIS-style) that manages PC control, Gmail, GitHub, calendar, daily planning, reminders, and family updates. Memory lives in a wiki-style ~/.assistant/ folder: one INDEX.md entry point linking to topic indexes (IDENTITY, FAMILY, PROJECTS, TASKS, DAILY, HEALTH, REMINDERS, KNOWLEDGE), each linking into its own subfolder of small per-item files — low context even after years of history. Ambient activation, no slash command. Cross-skill aware: if a project already has its own memory skill (e.g. agent-memory), this skill stores only a pointer instead of duplicating detail.
